chunks: I mentioned the House to Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, and he said: “If they were to leave it abandoned for one single year, they would not be granted respite.”
And in another report: “The punishment would descend upon them.”

key_terms.الْبَيْتَ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.عَطَّلُوهُ: they left it abandoned or neglected
key_terms.لَمْ يُنَاظَرُوا: they would not be granted delay or respite

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about abandoning the Ka'bah and hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith stresses the grave consequence of abandoning the Ka'bah and neglecting hajj. It presents maintaining the sacred House as a matter of communal religious duty, the abandonment of which brings divine punishment.
